pulley.title: Pulley
steps: Dashboard → Download Cap Table (uncheck “All Time” for an as-of date), or Company → Reports → Detailed Cap Table → Generate.
Also download every signed document before Pulley closes on Dec 8, 2026.
Choose the .xlsx (or .csv) here. You'll check the columns next.

carta.title: Carta
steps: Cap Table → Run reports → “Open Cap Table report” if it's listed, otherwise the Cap table report (Detailed).
Also the Securities ledger and Stakeholder details reports, and download your signed documents from the Documents library.
Choose the .xlsx (or .csv) here. You'll check the columns next.

cake.title: Cake Equity
steps: Compliance → Reporting → Exports: Cap table (XLSX). SAFEs are in Noteholders (CSV).
Choose one file here. You'll check the columns next; import the SAFEs into the same sheet or add them after.

ocf.title: An OCF export (.zip)
steps: Any tool that exports Open Cap Table Format gives a .zip with a manifest. It imports with its full history.

sheet.title: Any spreadsheet
steps: One row per holding: name, type, shares, dates, and SAFE amounts. You'll match the columns next.

phrases: consent of the board of directors
